scale.here: the same count, each subscribed to the whole area
scale.why: the reference picture has no viewport throttle; whole-area subscriptions are the worst case

not_generated.why: the reference target has no manned intake; in a systems run the ANSP adapter polls a sim-adsb the load harness does not serve, so the USSP shows manned traffic unavailable (its degraded state, in the report)

in a systems run the harness's peer USSP (peer) is the second USSP on the lab DSS: it serves its own flights and is notified of the fleet's intents in the U-space square, but files no intent of its own, so no conflict between the two USSPs is made (the reference target has no DSS or peer)

not_generated.source: authority DP polls of the USSPs (05 §1: one view per 1 Hz), against the reference target
